Class TurnOrderSlot

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Board.TurnOrderSlot
public class TurnOrderSlot extends Object
Represents a single slot within the turn order track. Each slot can hold a single player's totem, determines turn order, and applies a specific food modifier (bonus or malus) to the occupying player.
